source: Anthropic published list prices, recorded 2026-08-18. Prices are config: adding a model or changing a rate is a config edit, never a code change.

anthropic:claude-sonnet-5.note: Introductory 2.00/10.00 through 2026-08-31; metered at the standard rate so the unit cost does not jump when the promotion ends.

mock:mock-extractor-v1.note: The mock stands in for the frontier model and is priced at its rates, so a mock-mode cost rollup is a real arithmetic estimate on real token counts rather than a made-up number.

mock:mock-extractor-small-v1.note: Stands in for the cheap tier that handles the bulk of documents under routing.
